selection.json.rule: Among {HYB, NF-anchored}, a variant is eligible iff RENAME FA <= 0.10 on (i), (ii) and (iii). Among eligible variants, FREEZE the one with the higher E stratified AUROC under R_AB. Tie (|diff| < 0.005) -> NF-anchored (single-map variant with fewer agreements, less over-alignment risk). If neither is eligible: no rename-invariant consensus exists here; report both as failed and state that the R_COMP read uses ALIGN. R_COMP never takes part.
selection.json.note: NEITHER ELIGIBLE: no rename-invariant consensus exists here; both reported as failed; the R_COMP read uses ALIGN.
selection.json.caveat: E is DEVELOPMENT data for this choice (2 candidates): the E AUROC of the frozen variant is optimistically selected; the held-out read is the sibling's R_COMP run.
